entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who goes seeking Jaya Ballard to gain more power against Nicol Bolas and ends up in Yavimaya.

entities.name: Mother Luti
entities.description: An old, respected woman at Keral Keep who tries to teach Chandra and who reappears on Dominaria claiming Jaya's goggles as hers.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A metal being with a human-like face who has been gone a long time and fights Multani's animated trees.

entities.name: Steward Baird
entities.description: The Steward of Argive who leads a troop against Prossh's kobolds with a pyromancer's help.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: An elemental in a semiconscious state who instinctively animates trees to attack.

entities.name: Prossh
entities.description: A dragon worshipped by the kobolds of the Kher Ridges.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who left Chandra and the group.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker friend of Chandra's, taking Liliana's side.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon Chandra wants more power to fight.

entities.name: Jaya's Goggles
entities.description: Goggles kept as a relic at Keral Keep that Chandra takes to give to Jaya.

entities.name: Kobolds of the Kher Ridges
entities.description: Kobolds who worship Prossh and ambush the Argivian troop.

entities.name: Animated Trees
entities.description: Trees sent by Multani that attack any movement.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: A monastery on Regatha where Chandra once served as abbot.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's home plane of volcanoes.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Chandra searches for Jaya.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where the group failed against Bolas.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Nissa went to help repair.

entities.name: Argivia
entities.description: The capital city of New Argive, preparing for a kobold attack.

entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: Rocky ridges home to the kobolds.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: A thickly forested island where Karn and Multani are.

events.summary: Chandra returns to Regatha and sneaks into Keral Keep.
events.quote: Chandra walked across the planes to Regatha.

events.summary: Chandra reveals she sensed Jaya Ballard's aether trail on Dominaria.
events.quote: Just after Nissa disappeared, Chandra had noticed fresh traces of a powerful pyromancer's aether trail on Dominaria.

events.summary: Chandra takes Jaya's goggles from the monastery's relics and is caught by Luti.
events.quote: Chandra, what are you doing?

events.summary: Chandra explains she needs more power to fight Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: I need more power to fight Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Chandra rejects Luti's advice and leaves for Dominaria.
events.quote: But Chandra had already turned, ghostly fire flaring up around her as she stepped out of the plane.

events.summary: Chandra arrives in Argivia, which is preparing for a kobold attack.
events.quote: This place was Argivia, the capital city of New Argive

events.summary: A townswoman tells Chandra about the kobolds and Prossh and a pyromancer helping Steward Baird.
events.quote: it's the kobolds of the Kher Ridges again, and that horrible god-dragon of theirs, Prossh.

events.summary: Chandra finds a dead Argivian scout on the road.
events.quote: realized it was a dead body.

events.summary: Chandra sees kobolds building an ambush barricade in the name of Prossh.
events.quote: They were building a barricade across the road

events.summary: Chandra fights off kobolds that discover her.
events.quote: Chandra sent a fireball into the first kobold's chest and he tumbled back down the hill, screeching.

events.summary: Chandra blasts through the barricade to clear the way for the Argivians.
events.quote: She sent the burst of fire streaking toward the logs.

events.summary: Chandra loses control and fries half a dozen kobolds with a wild blast.
events.quote: The carefully targeted stream of fire turned into a wild blast that fried the half dozen kobolds in its path.

events.summary: The Argivian troop routs the kobolds.
events.quote: but it quickly turned into a rout.

events.summary: Baird tells Chandra the pyromancer Jaya Ballard left the force.
events.quote: Yes, that is her, but she left our force in the ridges.

events.summary: Baird says Jaya came looking for a friend and went toward Yavimaya.
events.quote: To the Yavimaya forest, I believe.

events.summary: Chandra reaches the coast across from Yavimaya.
events.quote: This had to be Yavimaya.

events.summary: Chandra sees trees trembling and hears fighting in Yavimaya.
events.quote: Suddenly a whole section of huge trees on an inland hillside rippled and trembled

events.summary: Chandra finds giant automatons digging a crater.
events.quote: They were each around twenty feet high, with scoops for hands and big blocky heads.

events.summary: Animated trees attack and tear apart an automaton.
events.quote: It leapt on the nearest automaton and ripped it apart.

events.summary: A small automaton warns Chandra that the trees attack any movement.
events.quote: Take care. They will attack any movement.

events.summary: The automaton says Multani animated the trees.
events.quote: They're animated trees, created and sent by Multani.

events.summary: Chandra burns a row of attacking trees.
events.quote: She reached a spot of higher ground where she had a better angle and sent a stream of fire down the whole row of trees.

events.summary: Karn explains Multani is injured and acts out of instinct.
events.quote: Multani is an elemental, and has been in a semiconscious state

events.summary: Karn reveals he is the friend who has been gone a long time.
events.quote: I'm Karn. And I am someone who has been gone for a long time.

events.summary: Mother Luti appears in Yavimaya and claims the goggles, revealing herself as Jaya.
events.quote: I believe those are mine.

relations.note: Luti is always trying to teach Chandra.
relations.quote: she was always trying to get Chandra to learn things Chandra didn't have time for.

relations.note: Multani animates and sends them instinctively.
relations.quote: They're animated trees, created and sent by Multani.
We will kill the Argivians for the glory of Prossh!

relations.note: Steward of Argive leading its troop.
relations.quote: Steward Baird's got a troop of soldiers and a powerful pyromancer to settle them.
They were building a barricade across the road

relations.note: Chandra helps the Argivians and receives thanks.
relations.quote: Steward Baird would like to thank you.

relations.note: The trees attack Karn and his automatons.
relations.quote: It leapt on the nearest automaton and ripped it apart.
